Name: RSM Plolynomial Identification TRE (RSMPI)
Description: The Replacement Sensor Model Polynomial Identification TRE (RSMPI) associates a RSM (rational) polynomial ground-to-image function with an image. The TRE gives general information regarding the polynomial geometric image / ground relationship. In particular, it identifies which image section is applicable to an arbitrary ground point. The RSM image domain may consist of a single section or it may be divided into at most 56 sections. Each section has its own unique (rational) polynomial ground-to-image function, defined in its own RSM polynomial coefficient TRE (RSMPC). Most images require only one section.

IID.Name: Image Identifier
IID.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the original full image that corresponds to the associated image. This is not to be confused with the identification of an image derived by filtering, chipping, re-sampling, or other such image-to-image transformations.

EDITION.Name: RSM Image Support Data Edition
EDITION.Description: This field contains a character string that uniquely identifies the RSM support data for the associated original full image. It is to consist of an identifier of up to 20 characters for the processor that generated the RSM support data, to which is appended up to 20 characters that are unique among RSM TRE sets that are generated by that processor.

R0.Name: Low Order Polynomial Constant Coefficient for Row
R0.Description: This field provides the constant term used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of X for Row
RX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of x used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of X for Row
RY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of y used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of X for Row
RZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of z used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RXX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XX for Row
RXX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xx used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RXY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XY for Row
RXY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xy used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RXZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XZ for Row
RXZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xz used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RYY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YY for Row
RYY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yy used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RYZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YZ for Row
RYZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yz used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

RZZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of ZZ for Row
RZZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of zz used in the approximate image row position low order polynomial.

C0.Name: Low Order Polynomial Constant Coefficient for Column
C0.Description: This field provides the constant term used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of X for Column
CX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of x used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of Y for Column
CY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of y used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of Z for Column
CZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of z used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CXX.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XX for Column
CXX.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xx used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CXY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XY for Column
CXY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xy used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CXZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of XY for Column
CXZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of xz used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CYY.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YY for Column
CYY.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yy used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CYZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of YZ for Column
CYZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of yz used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

CZZ.Name: Low Order Polynomial Coefficient of ZZ for Column
CZZ.Description: This field provides the coefficient of zz used in the approximate image column position low order polynomial.

RNIS.Name: Row Number of Image Sections
RNIS.Description: This field identifies the number of sections the RSM image domain is divided into along the row direction for representation of the ground-to-image relationship.

CNIS.Name: Column Number of Image Sections
CNIS.Description: This field identifies the number of sections the RSM image domain is divided into along the column direction for representation of the ground-to-image relationship.

TNIS.Name: Total Number of Image Sections
TNIS.Description: This field contains the total number of rectangular sections the RSM image domain is divided into for representation of the ground-to-image relationship. The value in this field is the product of the values in the RNIS and CNIS fields. Thus, the value of the field TNIS, with a maximum of 256, places constraints on the values of the fields RNIS and CNIS. This number represents the total number of RSMPC TREs.

RSSIZ.Name: Section Size in Rows
RSSIZ.Description: This field contains the number of rows contained in a single section. Note that its value is represented as a positive non-integer because it equals the number of rows in the RSM image domain divided by the number of sections in the row direction, not necessarily an integer value.

CSSIZ.Name: Section Size in Columns
CSSIZ.Description: This field contains the number of columns contained in a single section. Note that its value is represented as a positive non-integer. Note that its value is represented as a positive non-integer because it equals the number of columns in the RSM image domain divided by the number of sections in the column direction, not necessarily an integer value.
